elements.requirement: Section 5B of the Bail Act 1976 is inserted after section 5A of that Act.
elements.quote: After the section 5A of the Bail Act 1976 inserted by Schedule 3 to this Act there shall be inserted the following section

elements.requirement: Where a magistrates' court or a constable has granted bail in criminal proceedings for a qualifying offence, that court or the appropriate court in relation to the constable may, on application by the prosecutor, reconsider the decision and vary the conditions of bail, impose conditions on unconditional bail, or withhold bail.
elements.quote: Where a magistrates’ court has granted bail in criminal proceedings in connection with an offence, or proceedings for an offence, to which this section applies or a constable has granted bail in criminal proceedings in connection with proceedings for such an offence, that court or the appropriate court in relation to the constable may, on application by the prosecutor for the decision to be reconsidered,— avary the conditions of bail,bimpose conditions in respect of bail which has been granted unconditionally, orcwithhold bail.

elements.requirement: The offences to which reconsideration applies are offences triable on indictment and offences triable either way.
elements.quote: The offences to which this section applies are offences triable on indictment and offences triable either way.

elements.requirement: A prosecutor may not make an application for reconsideration of a bail decision unless it is based on information not available to the court or constable when the original decision was taken.
elements.quote: No application for the reconsideration of a decision under this section shall be made unless it is based on information which was not available to the court or constable when the decision was taken.

elements.requirement: The magistrates' court must take the reconsideration decision in accordance with section 4(1) and Schedule 1 of the Bail Act 1976, regardless of whether the person to whom the application relates appears before it.
elements.quote: Whether or not the person to whom the application relates appears before it, the magistrates’ court shall take the decision in accordance with section 4(1) (and Schedule 1) of this Act.

elements.requirement: Where the court reconsiders a decision and withholds bail from a person who is present before the court, the court must remand that person in custody.
elements.quote: Where the decision of the court on a reconsideration under this section is to withhold bail from the person to whom it was originally granted the court shall— aif that person is before the court, remand him in custody

elements.requirement: Where the court reconsiders a decision and withholds bail from a person who is not present before the court, the court must order that person to surrender himself forthwith into the custody of the court.
elements.quote: if that person is not before the court, order him to surrender himself forthwith into the custody of the court.

elements.requirement: Where a person surrenders into the custody of the court pursuant to an order made on reconsideration of bail, the court must remand that person in custody.
elements.quote: Where a person surrenders himself into the custody of the court in compliance with an order under subsection (5) above, the court shall remand him in custody.

elements.requirement: A constable may arrest a person without a warrant if that person has been ordered to surrender to custody following reconsideration of bail and fails to surrender in accordance with the order without reasonable cause.
elements.quote: A person who has been ordered to surrender to custody under subsection (5) above may be arrested without warrant by a constable if he fails without reasonable cause to surrender to custody in accordance with the order.

elements.requirement: A person arrested for failing to surrender to custody must be brought before a justice of the peace for the petty sessions area of arrest as soon as practicable and within 24 hours of arrest.
elements.quote: A person arrested in pursuance of subsection (7) above shall be brought as soon as practicable, and in any event within 24 hours after his arrest, before a justice of the peace for the petty sessions area in which he was arrested

elements.requirement: The justice of the peace before whom an arrested person is brought must remand that person in custody.
elements.quote: and the justice shall remand him in custody.

elements.requirement: Christmas Day, Good Friday, or any Sunday must not be counted when calculating the 24-hour period following an arrest for failure to surrender.
elements.quote: In reckoning for the purposes of this subsection any period of 24 hours, no account shall be taken of Christmas Day, Good Friday or any Sunday.

elements.requirement: Magistrates' court rules must require notice of an application for reconsideration and of its grounds, including notice of the court's available powers, to be given to the affected person.
elements.quote: Magistrates’ court rules shall include provision— arequiring notice of an application under this section and of the grounds for it to be given to the person affected, including notice of the powers available to the court under it;

elements.requirement: Magistrates' court rules must secure that any representations made by the affected person, whether in writing or orally, are considered by the court before it makes its decision.
elements.quote: for securing that any representations made by the person affected (whether in writing or orally) are considered by the court before making its decision;

elements.requirement: Magistrates' court rules must designate which court is the appropriate court in relation to a constable's decision to grant bail.
elements.quote: designating the court which is the appropriate court in relation to the decision of any constable to grant bail.

thresholds.what: the maximum time limit following arrest within which an arrested person must be brought before a justice of the peace
thresholds.quote: in any event within 24 hours after his arrest
